originality.rationale: Anantharaman 2019 explicitly poses an unclassified central cube-slice zonoid question and supplies examples in dimension four only; the full 2023 open-access rendition was read throughout its main four sections. The prior four-box classification already handles only dimension four, and is not the contribution. The new noncentral box-slice center-rigidity lemma works for every number of active coordinates and proves classification for unbounded ambient dimension. Volume-critical section and fiber-body results do not imply zonotope membership of fixed sections. Literature and database searches cannot establish uniqueness; the priority risk is stated.
residual_risks: Historical priority: some older oriented-matroid or cube-slice literature might encode the same all-dimensional dominance criterion in different language, despite the exact published 2019 question remaining open there.
Only primary Anantharaman full text was examined comprehensively; classical Shephard and Ambrus sources compared via accessible result statements/abstracts, not complete texts.
The present geometric proof is self-contained and checked with exact arithmetic but remains same-model reviewed, without independent validation.

value.rationale: A 2019 primary paper explicitly asked for the full central-cube-section zonoid characterization and gave only examples. This gives the first all-dimension classification supported by this search, an explicit decision test, and a structural all-dimensional off-center-section rigidity theorem needed beyond previously resolved d=4. The classification unites all support and equality strata and is not a routine low-dimensional parameter increment.
